svg.title: Separate Umbra profiles
svg.desc: Research and work are two example profiles. Each profile has its own agent session, daemon, tabs, cookie store and downloads. The lanes stay separate so parallel agents do not change each other's current tab or sign-in state.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One profile per independent browser identity
